entities.name: RimO methylthiotransferase
observations: The 445-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry B3DYX1 from Methylacidiphilum infernorum.
RimO catalyzes methylthiolation of an aspartate residue in ribosomal protein uS12; curated EC number is EC 2.8.4.4.
Homologous reviewed RimO proteins show 48.8–50.1% identity over approximately 98–99% of the sequence and carry the same catalytic annotation.

entities.name: uS12 aspartate methylthiolation
observations: Rhea-mapped reaction: an aspartate residue of ribosomal protein uS12 is converted to 3-methylsulfanyl-aspartate using two S-adenosyl-L-methionine molecules, a sulfur-carrier thiol, and reducing equivalents; products include 5'-deoxyadenosine, L-methionine, S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, oxidized sulfur carrier, and protons.
The curated reaction is associated with EC 2.8.4.4 and RHEA:37087; the detailed mapped reaction is represented by RHEA:10460, RHEA:10461, RHEA:14737, and RHEA:14739.
